verdict.rationale: Rippling's platform docs describe a native rule/workflow engine that fires on events—building custom workflows to notify people or automate tasks (e.g., triggering a bonus reminder), automating a Slack alert based on a Zendesk ticket, and enforcing dynamic role-based permission rules across apps once defined. This directly matches 'define rules that trigger actions on events.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the workflow builder's reliability and scope, and clearer detail on how granular/custom the trigger-condition-action model is (vs. pre-built templates).
